## 3dslibris 2.7.6

Small settings update for controlling startup behavior.

### New Features

* #140: added a global **reopen last book** setting so startup can either open the last-read book automatically or stay in the library.

### Bug Fixes

* #141: fixed EPUB `text-align: right` and `text-align: center` rendering when publisher CSS block margins also move the line start.
* #142: enabled EPUB inline GIF decoding and fixed centered/right-aligned EPUB ornaments when publisher block margins shift the line start or the ornament is the only paragraph content.
